7 – IN CORPORATE COLLABORATION,
HARDWARE STARTUPS LOOK FOR CO-
DEVELOPMENT AND EXPERTISE
Roughly two thirds of startups at Slush 2019
filled out a separate application about the way
in which they wish to engage with corporates
at Slush. According to that data, software
startups are primarily looking for market
access, while hardware companies prioritize
co-development and expertise.
